# The endur pack

*Endur* · version 1.0.0 · code `ENDR`

## What it is

Endur is the commodity and energy trading and risk system. Its trades arrive in the common UPPER_SNAKE trade schema, so the mapping is the identity.
This pack is one source of the canonical `trade` kind: its rows carry `SOURCE_SYSTEM = ENDUR`. It is a pack of the `trading-systems` module that
extends `trading`; switch it on or off in Admin -> Artifacts (the pack is the switch).

## Data structures

Every kind the pack owns, read from its manifest, its samples and its Sutras: how its ids look, its fields (type, an example, what it means), its nested lists and the fields that link to other kinds. A path `A[].B` is field `B` of every element of list `A`.

## Screens and commands

| Command | Kind | Opens |
|---|---|---|
| `ENDR` | — | The pack's overview: its kinds, how many each holds, an example of each |

Screens (Sutras):

| Sutra | Kind | What it shows |
|---|---|---|
| `endur-callnot` | `trade` | An Endur call-notice deposit: interest periods, then the principal on notice. |
| `endur-cash` | `trade` | An Endur cash deal: a payment or a fee in one currency, on one date. |
| `endur-comfut` | `trade` | An Endur exchange-traded commodity future: one leg, one settlement against the index. |
| `endur-commodity` | `trade` | An Endur physical commodity deal: a delivery leg in the commodity's unit and a payment leg. |
| `endur-comswap` | `trade` | An Endur commodity swap: fixed price against the average of a floating index (or two indexes, a basis), month by month. |

Sections it adds to other pages (shown only for the rows named, and only while the pack is on):

| Kind | Shown when | Section |
|---|---|---|
| `trade` | `$.SOURCE_SYSTEM == 'ENDUR'` | `sutras/endur-native-fields.v1.section.yaml` |

## Enabling and dependencies

Builds on the packs `trading`.

The connectors it brings (written once to `config/connectors/<name>.yaml`, then the site's own):

| Connector | Plugin | Kinds | Enabled |
|---|---|---|---|
| `trade-endur` | `delta` | `trade` | `${DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED:true}` |
| `trade-endur-live` | `kafka` | `trade` | `${DRISHTI_STREAM_ENDUR:false}` |

Settings (environment variables) its connectors read: `DRISHTI_ENDUR_TOPIC`, `DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED`, `DRISHTI_STREAM_ENDUR`, `DRISHTI_STREAM_STALE_AFTER`.
